{{Quote|Your power relay inverters can't handle too many hard power-ups!|Han Solo warns Salculd about breaking her inverters|<ref name="Assault at Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref>}}
'''Power relay inverters''' were a ship part used during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They could become damaged if a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] preformed too many hard power-ups.
